t: Two classroom plans for teaching students to build stories in Twine.
steps: Find the Teaching with Twine blog page and download the slide PDFs and the lesson plan.
Decide between Twine 2.0 in a browser or Twine 1.4 downloaded.
Ask IT to check the Twine version on student computers.
Try the plan yourself on one computer.
Note any menu differences in newer versions.
Choose a story prompt for the first session.
Decide whether to run the one day or two day plan.
